=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/lint_gh_calls_in_loops.py:438-456 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The per-file `try / except RuntimeError:` in `lint()` catches only `RuntimeError`. If `_git()` raises `OSError` or `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` (`subprocess.run(... timeout=GIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)`, lines 109-116), the error goes to the outer `except (RuntimeError, OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):` handler, and every finding already collected is thrown away.
  WHY: One slow or failed `git show` for one changed file produces `GH_LOOP_CALL_LINT outcome=skipped reason=git_error` with no warnings for any other file. That breaks the documented contract of skipping only the bad file, and `test_one_unreadable_path_keeps_other_findings` tests only the `RuntimeError` branch. Severity disagrees: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and minimax_minimax-m3 rated MAJOR, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated NIT, and the highest is used here. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 filed this only as hardening, not as a defect.
- scripts/lint_gh_calls_in_loops.py:452-453 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `warnings.extend(scan_file(path, text, added[path]))` runs a hand-written lexer over file content the PR controls, outside the per-file `try / except RuntimeError:`. Any exception it raises (`IndexError`, `RecursionError`, `re.error`, …) reaches the outer handler, which drops the warnings for every other changed file.
  WHY: A crafted or very large workflow `run:` block in a single file (deep nesting, or an unclosed heredoc with a `<<-` token the parser does not handle) turns the lint from "warning" into "skipped" for the whole PR. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash mention `scan_file()` being outside the guard inside the git-error finding above. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says a scan_file exception is caught by main()'s `except Exception` (`reason=internal_error`, exit 0).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Always exits 0. It prints a summary line `GH_LOOP_CALL_LINT warnings=<n> files=<n>`."
  expected_change_site: scripts/lint_gh_calls_in_loops.py `main()` argument parsing (around lines 462-467)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `parser.parse_args(argv)` at line 467 runs before the `try/except` block, so a missing or invalid `--base` makes argparse exit with status 2, not 0. The docstring carves out argparse usage errors ("It exits 0 on every path except an argparse usage error (exit 2)."), and the workflow runs the script with `|| true` plus `continue-on-error: true`, so the impact in CI is nil but the strict spec is not met. All flaggers rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this gap.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

Suggested fix: `except (RuntimeError, OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):`, 1 line. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
